[[File:Marcus Sheppard DecipherCon 1999 portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Marcus Sheppard at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Marcus Sheppard''' worked for Decipher Inc. in European marketing. Decipher's [[DecipherCon 1999]] photographs name him as one of "Decipher's Euro Marketing crew", over from the UK.<ref name="sun16">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000621164815/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SUN/sun16.html DecipherCon 1999 Sunday photo sun16], Decipher (Wayback 21 June 2000). Caption: "Marcus Sheppard of Decipher's Euro Marketing crew> He came from the UK to lend a hand"</ref> He signed the 2001 European Championships announcement as "Marcus Sheppard, Decipher Inc. European Marketing Team".<ref name="euro2001">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/european2001.html "Everything You Always Wanted to Know About the European Championships"], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020614114255/http://www.decipher.com:80/tournaments/european2001.html Internet Archive]</ref> His [[DecipherCon 2002]] reports carry the byline "Marcus Sheppard, European Marketing Representative, Decipher Inc.".<ref name="d1">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1031dayonewrapup.html "And So It Begins: Day One Wrapup"], Marcus Sheppard, Decipher (31 October 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021106034543/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1031dayonewrapup.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="d4">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1103dayfourwrapup.html "Until Next Time: Day Four Wrapup"], Marcus Sheppard, Decipher (3 November 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030220124438/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1103dayfourwrapup.html Internet Archive]</ref>

He is credited on Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>
